According to NCERT principles for Section B1: Computer Science Core (Binary Search Maximum Comparisons for N=1000):
10 comparisons (since 2^10 = 1024 >= 1000)

Maximum comparisons in binary search = ceil(log2(n)). For n=1000, 2^10 = 1024, so maximum 10 comparisons are needed.
